title: Ways of Distinguishing Creatures
english: For there are many ways to distinguish the diversity and dissimilarity of these animals and winged creatures, says the Father.
First, [it is through] the saying 'and the Lord God formed out of the ground still' (Genesis 2:22); for we do not find any creation of God to be other than man.

Again, through the saying 'still', the scripture shows other animals and winged creatures to be prophesied here besides the former, for it has not been written that the first winged creatures came from the ground, but from the waters; but these came from the ground, or rather they were formed by the direct hand of God and not by command.
Likewise, through the saying that all winged creatures and all beasts were now formed by God, it does not give us room to say entirely that some came before, while a part [came] now from where [...]
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
